name: Hack Pack
description: A Mega Hack style toolkit: noclip, speedhack, FPS/TPS bypass, hitboxes, bot, music tools and more.

auto-safe.name: Auto Safe Mode
auto-safe.description: Automatically stops progress/completions from being saved while any cheat is active. Recommended.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Don't die from hazards and blocks.

noclip-limit-on.name: Noclip death limit
noclip-limit-on.description: Sub-option of Noclip: you die after hitting too many separate obstacles.

noclip-limit.name: Noclip death limit amount
noclip-limit.description: How many separate hits are allowed before you die (needs Noclip + death limit on).

tps-on.name: TPS bypass
tps-on.description: Changes physics ticks per second (default 240). Macros only replay correctly at the TPS they were recorded at.

reverb.name: Music reverb
reverb.description: Adds a reverb effect to the level music.

practice-music.name: Practice music hack
practice-music.description: Syncs the music to your checkpoint when you respawn in practice mode.

jump-hack.name: Jump hack (experimental)
jump-hack.description: Jump anywhere, even in the air.

auto-complete.name: Auto complete
auto-complete.description: Instantly completes the level. Progress is never saved when this is on.

bot-mode.name: Bot mode
bot-mode.description: Record your inputs, then Replay them. One macro is saved per level.
